description: This C# source file defines classes for serializing, deserializing, and copying multi-dimensional arrays within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes a codec class for writing and reading multi-dimensional arrays to/from a wire format, and a copier class for deep copying such arrays.

classes.name: MultiDimensionalArrayCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for multi-dimensional arrays, handling serialization and deserialization to a wire protocol.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a multi-dimensional array to the output writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader to reconstruct the multi-dimensional array.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is an array supported by this codec.

classes.name: MultiDimensionalArrayCopier<T>
classes.description: Provides deep copy functionality for multi-dimensional arrays.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the array, copying individual elements.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is an array supported for copying.
